roles_system_or_tenant.name: roles_system_or_tenant
roles_system_or_tenant.value:
("roles"."is_system" and "roles"."tenant_id" is null and "roles"."key" is not null)
        or (not "roles"."is_system" and "roles"."tenant_id" is not null)

tenant_branding_logo_complete.name: tenant_branding_logo_complete
tenant_branding_logo_complete.value: ("tenant_branding"."logo_data" IS NULL) = ("tenant_branding"."logo_content_type" IS NULL) AND ("tenant_branding"."logo_data" IS NULL) = ("tenant_branding"."logo_etag" IS NULL)

plans_limits_positive.name: plans_limits_positive
plans_limits_positive.value: ("plans"."connector_limit" is null or "plans"."connector_limit" > 0) and ("plans"."user_limit" is null or "plans"."user_limit" > 0)
